story.title: GoKwik Launches AI-Powered Kwik Ship to Cut Failed E-Commerce Deliveries by 20% Across India
story.summary: GoKwik has launched Kwik Ship, an AI-powered logistics platform designed to reduce failed deliveries by up to 20% for Indian e-commerce brands. The system uses AI-powered calls and automated WhatsApp notifications to keep customers informed and provides more accurate delivery time estimates at checkout. The platform directly addresses one of Indian e-commerce's most persistent pain points — high return-to-origin rates caused by failed deliveries.
